description: A Hermes home in use is no target until the user's "targets" name hermes (spec §16.2), and a project cannot add it: a CLI sync under HERMES_HOME=~/hermes-a, with Claude Code alone detected and the project narrowed to ["hermes"], installs the user's skill for Claude Code, nothing in the project or the Hermes home, with the project's warning; status names the project scope's targets as none.
